conviction_note: Pre-revenue biotech whose Q3 numbers carry nothing; the move sits in the guidance lines: the toddler (1-3) BLA, guided for H2 2026 in March and April, dropped from the July release, with COMFORT Toddlers' primary completion registered for 2026-11; and the runway restatement. Add the name's own habit of falling the session after a quarterly release (8 of 9 since mid-2024) and p_up is 40 on a 6.5% absolute move. The findings sum to -3.4 against a scaled -1.3; the gap is the share of the move I cannot sign, plus the fact that the Q3 date is not issuer-confirmed.

new_in_release.expect: Toddler (1-3) BLA timing. Guided 'second half of 2026 under an Accelerated Approval Pathway' in March and April, left out of the July release, and the call summary made it 'contingent on study completion'. COMFORT Toddlers' primary completion is 2026-11. I lean to a slip into 2027 (negative) or a vaguer date; reaffirming year-end 2026 would be a small positive.

Sept 30 cash: my rough estimate is around $170-180m (174.9 + ~48 net ATM - Q3 burn). The runway statement has to clear 12 months from about 2026-10-28, i.e. 'into Q4 2027'. I expect them to reach it, as they have at every print, but it is a knife-edge.
BLA status: FDA filing acceptance and the Priority Review decision fall due by day 60, about 2026-11-28. Not expected in this release unless the FDA moved early.
Opex and net loss of about $50m a quarter. Irrelevant to the reaction.

bar: No usable EPS bar: Yahoo's 3-analyst EPS series (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v10/finance/quoteSummary/DBV.PA?modules=earningsHistory%2CfinancialData) is not on a consistent per-share basis, and EPS does not move this name. The bars that matter are the company's own guides: the toddler BLA 'anticipated in the second half of 2026' (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1613780/000119312526126671/d113165dex991.htm, 2026-03-26; reaffirmed https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1613780/000119312526197921/d132063dex991.htm, 2026-04-30) and the runway 'into third quarter of 2027' (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1613780/000119312526306222/d156695dex991.htm).
session_check: amc. DBV publishes after both the Paris and US closes. The Q3 2025 8-K was accepted at 2025-10-28T21:40Z, Q2 2026 at 2026-07-16T21:02Z, and the Q2 AMF filing went out at 20:01Z (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001613780.json; AMF flux). The window is therefore close 2026-10-28 to close 2026-10-29. The DATE is NOT issuer-confirmed. TradingView, AJ Bell and the Divaltis agenda say 2026-10-28, and Q3 2025 came out on exactly 2025-10-28. Earnings Whispers says 2026-11-04 (https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/w/DBVT). I found no 'to report' notice; DBV gave the Q2 one two days ahead (https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/dbv-technologies-to-report-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-business-update-on-july-16-2026). Phantom risk is material.
positioning_check: AMF register read (covered: true, as_of 2026-10-22, https://www.data.gouv.fr/api/1/datasets/r/c2539d1c-8531-4937-9cba-3bd8e9786cc5): 2.89% net short across 4 disclosed sellers, down from 2.99% ten days earlier. Mildly covering, not crowded. Separately, MPM BioImpact is a long holder that has been selling, now at 4.84% (AMF 2026-10-16). JP Morgan's back-and-forth 10% crossings (AMF 2026-09-25, 09-29, 10-16) are prime-broker and depositary assimilation, not a directional holder.

findings.finding: The toddler (1-3) BLA guide, 'second half of 2026', looks unreachable and the release is likely to move it. It was dropped from the July release, and ClinicalTrials.gov registers COMFORT Toddlers' primary completion for 2026-11, which leaves weeks to get from data to a filing. The 4-7 BLA took about nine months from VITESSE topline and slipped once.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: When the 4-7 BLA slipped one quarter (2026-06-29 amc), DBV.PA fell 1.6% the next session after being down 12% at the open (Boursier via Fortuneo, https://bourse.fortuneo.fr/actualites-amp/dbv-technologies-sous-pression-5023963). It then fell 7.3% on the Q2 release that restated it (2026-07-17).
findings.why_not_priced: The slip is my inference, joining a registry field (https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies?query.term=COMFORT%20Toddlers%20Viaskin, primary completion 2026-11, updated 2026-07-22) to a guide the company has quietly stopped repeating. No source I found, French or English, flags the toddler date as at risk. Coverage is 3 analysts and the French press only covers the 4-7 BLA. If it were priced, the stock would not have the +5.7% five-day bounce it carries into the print. The 25% slide since the BLA submission is partly this and partly unexplained.
findings.independence: Q2 call summary: the toddler filing is 'contingent on study completion' (https://quartr.com/events/dbv-technologies-s-a-dbv-q2-2026_oCBAvuRp). The July PR omitted the H2-2026 toddler guide that the March and April PRs carried (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1613780/000119312526306222/d156695dex991.htm).

findings.finding: The runway restatement is a knife-edge. My rough estimate of Sept 30 cash is $170-180m, from June's $174.9m plus about $48m of net ATM proceeds minus a Q2-rate burn of about $51m. The 10-Q issued about 2026-10-28 must show 12 months, 'into Q4 2027', to avoid substantial-doubt language. The company has reset its runway to just past 12 months at every print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 (runway 'into Q2 2027') fell 7.5% the next session; Q2 2026 ('into Q3 2027', with BLA timing) fell 7.3%. Both prints mixed the runway with other news.
findings.why_not_priced: Sell-side models carry the ATM, so an 'into Q4 2027' restatement would be neutral. The negative tail is going-concern language, or an announced need for capital before launch with $100m of ATM capacity left and the stock 26% below RA Capital's $13.67 entry. The financing itself buys launch readiness and was taken by a specialist holder, so its sign is not negative. Net small.
findings.independence: The ATM sale PR (https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/MKW/2026/07/FCMKW115341_20260730.pdf) and the 314,388,807 share count at 2026-08-31 (https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/MKW/2026/09/FCMKW130738_20260902.pdf) show no later issuance. Same company documents, no external corroboration.

findings.finding: A long-holder overhang is still selling. MPM BioImpact crossed below 5% through on-market sales on 2026-09-28 and still holds 15.2m shares (4.84%), several sessions of combined Paris and Nasdaq volume.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell from €2.02 to €1.57 between the BLA submission and mid-October while MPM sold, then bounced to €1.82.

Ce franchissement de seuils résulte d'une cession d'actions DBV TECHNOLOGIES sur le marché. [MPM BioImpact declared crossing below 5% of capital on 28 Sept 2026 and holding 15,223,295 shares, 4.84%, as a result of on-market sales.]
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the filing has been public since 2026-10-16 and the October slide reflects it. What may not be priced is that a seller below 5% no longer has to file, so further sales into a results bounce are invisible. Kept small.

findings.finding: DBV.PA has fallen the session after 8 of its last 9 quarterly releases (2024-07 through 2026-07), median -4.7%, measured from Yahoo daily closes against EDGAR 8-K item-2.02 timestamps. The one exception was +0.3% (FY2025, 2026-03-27). I excluded the 2024-10-22 regulatory-update release (+34%).
findings.why_not_priced: This is a base rate, not news. It is contaminated by a downtrend (the stock is down from €3.6 in May to €1.8), and nine prints is a small sample. Sized small. The baseline's cadence-estimated history (median 5.8, mixed signs) does not show it, because its dates are mostly not print days.
findings.independence: EDGAR 8-K acceptance times (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001613780.json) set the event dates; the moves come from the same Yahoo series.

COMFORT Toddlers DBPC treatment-period primary completion, registered for 2026-11, and its topline.

baseline_tension: The findings cut against the baseline's +2.46 priced lean, which comes mostly from the 2.89% disclosed short read as squeeze fuel. That short is small and covering, so I do not treat it as a reason the market is wrong. They also cut against the +5.7% five-day bounce, and agree with the -10.4% 20-day and -21.9% 60-day slide.
language_note: The AMF threshold-crossing filings (French only) carried MPM BioImpact's on-market sale below 5% and showed JP Morgan's 10% crossings to be assimilation rather than a directional stake. No English source carried either.

Boursier, via Fortuneo, carried Portzamparc's read of the June BLA slip ('probabilités inchangées', target €4.90, 'renforcer') and the intraday -12% on 2026-06-30. The English sources carried only the US analysts.
The load-bearing documents (the toddler guide, runway, the ATM) are bilingual company PRs. French sources added nothing on the guidance lines.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance change median 9.0%): the toddler-BLA finding is resized on the guidance scale, -1.5 to -2.0, and abs_move_pct goes from 5.5 to 6.5 because a guidance change is plausibly about 45% likely.
'Financing is a question': the ATM bought launch readiness and was taken by a specialist holder, so the runway finding drops from -0.5 to -0.3 (only the going-concern tail is negative).

'Let the reaction history move p_up, not abs_move_pct' and the core's rule to apply each lesson once: the 8-of-9 sell-off base rate stays in p_up (40) and its own finding is trimmed from -1.0 to -0.8 rather than counted twice.

'Understatement is the systematic error': abs_move_pct is no longer anchored on the baseline's cadence median. That median is flagged a lower bound; the observed median abs reaction is 4.7% and a guidance line is in play.
